data.name: Eliza
data.description:
Eliza is the mother of Kimba and mate of Caesar. She’s captured by poachers and used as bait to slaughter her mate. Then she’s put on a ship, where she gives birth to her son and 2 months later sends him back to the jungle. That very night, a storm starts and Eliza sinks with the ship. A picture of her in the stars appeared to Leo.

Before the incident of "Go, White Lion!"

Eliza would be raped by a brown lion named Joshua when she was about 18-19 years old, causing her to give birth to a lion named Joey.  she would escape from Joshua with Joey. 
she would meet a white lion named Panja when she was roughly 21 years old.  
when she was 24, she would have her first child with Panja, a daughter named Leona.  

In Kimba the White Lion (1965-1966)

Eliza appears mainly in Ep. 1 - Go, White Lion! and also is a minor character in other episodes appearing in flashbacks. She’s a supportive mate to Caesar, but she fears for his safety every time he goes into the village to free the livestock into the jungle. She’s tricked by hearing a recording of Caesar's roar and gets captured by the human hunters. She’s used as bait in order for the humans to capture the white lion Caesar. Caesar tells Eliza in his dying wishes to name their unborn son, "Kimba". In success of the hunter's mission, Eliza. has been lifted onto a ship to be shipped off to a zoo.  
when Eliza was around 28 years old, she would get pregnant with a son from Panja.  Panja would later be killed by hunters with Eliza and Joey used as bait.  Eliza would be taken onto a ship along with Joey.  she would give birth to Leo on the ship at age 28.  3 months after she gave birth to Leo, she would instruct Joey and Leo to jump off the ship and find their way to Africa again.
the night after Leo and Joey jumped ship, Eliza would be stuck on board the MV Snakely still as it sailed into a storm, and under a series of unfortunate events, struck three naval mines that were practically thrown into the side by a wave, causing the vessel to sink.  Eliza would be killed due to drowning.  In other appearances, she’s seen in flashbacks by Kimba to give support by comforting or singing with him.

After the events of Go, White Lion!

several years later, Eliza would, through Magic, be brought back to life, alongside her mate Panja.
at about 37-38 years old, Eliza would have a daughter named Sophie with a Reformed Joshua.  
she lives to this day now and is rather happy with her life's standing. She is currently still 38 years old

Physical appearance

Eliza is a feral white lioness who is 38 years old.  she has cream-coloured fur with white fur on her belly and under her chin and neck.  she has a feline pussy, although she is not tight due to having had four cubs and her age.
